objective: Owner authorized GitHub Actions as a narrow exception to local-only work: one bounded, isolated no-Expo Android Gradle/JVM compile diagnostic without signing, APK upload, deployment or release.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main baseline source 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f; main was 7 commits ahead of native DEV and has not been reconciled. Neither production runtime nor installed Android client has been verified; this change touches only separate DEV CI and docs.
chosenApproach: One-shot branch/path/commit-message-gated push workflow, optional future dispatch after workflow is present in default branch; fixed Ubuntu/JDK/SDK/Gradle, focused source tests and compilation only. Full native release guard remains deliberately red; no APK build, signing or backend.
selectionRationale: No SDK, Android runner or Gradle toolchain in current execution environment. GitHub hosted runner can compile the isolated source and expose actual JVM/Android failures at bounded cost, unlike repeated nonfunctional Godot-only APK builds. Existing main remains untouched.
